content:
anya: heads-up - partner found emails in debug dumps. root cause: legacy proxy adds X-Route after logger so route-based scrub missed it. anyone got quick wins?

samir: ugh. quick win = cheap pre-scrub for obvious PII before routing.

lina: pre-scrub rules must be tiny (regex for email, cc, common api-key patterns). avoid NLP magic.

marta: perf: double-scrub can spike CPU and trigger quota/autoscale. can we edge-offload for public traffic?

ops-bot: note: enabling pre-scrub on a tenant raises per-token CPU ~10-18%.

anya: medium-term: route attestation. require proxies to send X-Route-Signature (HMAC) so we can validate before scrub and keep single pass.

samir: HMAC rollout = infra + proxy changes, timeline ~3-4w. need key rotation plan.

devex: Console impact: show badge "preflight-redacted" + tooltip. add toggle "view routed" vs "view preflight" and audit link.

lina: I'll draft a short RFC for `preflight_minimal` ruleset (emails, cc, ssn patterns, api keys). low FP priority.

marta: breakglass? propose one-time SRE+Legal approval token, TTL 5m, audit log, notify customer.

samir: add metrics: preflight_applied, post_scrub_leak_detects, breakglass_attempts, route_signature_failures. dashboard per-tenant.

anya: short-term decision: tenant-flagged preflight for ingress_untrusted routes. medium-term: implement signed-route flow and revert to single scrub for signed requests.

marta: will map high-volume tenants and suggest offload/tagging.

samir: will bench double-scrub vs signed-route single-scrub by Mon.

lina: RFC + PR for ruleset by Wed.

devex: docs + tooltip by Thu.

anya: thanks. if you spot other proxies mutating headers post-logger, ping me with example request id. ops-bot created ticket PRIV-ROUTE-001 for tracking.
